content_sections.heading: About GRID India Intern
content_sections.text: Grid Controller of India Limited (GRID-INDIA), a Miniratna-I & Schedule “A” CPSE, is a wholly owned Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Power. GRID-INDIA has been entrusted with the responsibility of operating the National Load Despatch Centre (NLDC) and the five Regional Load Despatch Centres (RLDCs). To address the growing need for specialized expertise due to renewable energy integration and new grid technologies, GRID-INDIA has introduced विद्युत प्रज्ञा - a specialised internship programme for Power System Simulation Studies.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The GRID India Intern recruitment offers a total of 15 vacancies distributed across different regional load despatch centres and the national centre. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The B.E./B.Tech. degree must have been completed on or before the closing date of application window. Candidates awaiting final undergraduate results or completion of degree/ essential qualifications requirements as on the date of closing of application window are not eligible to apply. Date of issuance of final marksheet shall be taken as the date of acquiring qualification. Full-Time, Regular course in M.Tech./MSR/ M.E in Power Systems or a closely related specialisation. Final semester students in M.Tech./ MSR/ ME are also eligible to apply. Ph. D in Power Systems or a closely related specialisation. Ph. D research scholars who are pursuing their degree are also eligible to apply. Candidates pursuing or have completed MSR/ Ph. D in Power Systems or a closely related specialisation must have a “No Objection Certificate” from their respective colleges/ universities. The applicant's age must be at least 18 years and not more than 32 years as on the closing date of the application window. Any Relaxation in Upper Age Limit shall be as per Government of India Directives. Relaxation in marks for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories will be pass marks.

rows.essential_qualification: Full Time Regular Course in B.E. /B.Tech./ B. Sc (Engg.)/ IDD (Integrated Dual Degree) from recognized University/ Institute in Electrical/ Electrical (Power)/ Electrical and Electronics/ Power Systems Engineering/ Power Engineering (Electrical) disciplines, with minimum 65% or equivalent CGPA.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected interns will receive an all-inclusive stipend of ₹50,000 Per Month, and no other allowances, benefits or emoluments shall be admissible. The duration of engagement is six (06) months, which is further extendable by three (03) months on mutual agreement, on the same terms & conditions.

content_sections.heading: GRID India Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: Interns will undergo training and work in the identified work area of Power System Simulation Studies, gaining structured exposure to practical applications of simulation and modelling tools in the Indian power system.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interaction
content_sections.text: The applicants shall be shortlisted on the basis of their fulfilment of prescribed essential eligibility criteria; preference will be given to candidates possessing desirable qualifications. Shortlisted candidates shall be called for an interaction at NLDC, New Delhi. No TA/ DA shall be paid to the candidates appearing for the interaction.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GRID India Intern
content_sections.text: Applications shall be invited through an online portal on the official GRID-INDIA website only. Fill out the application form with required details. Verify all marks and details carefully, ensuring CGPA equivalence is correctly calculated where applicable. Submit the online application on or before 6th November, 2026.
